QuestInfo.name: Live to Fight Another Day
QuestInfo.0: The monsters just won't stop coming. There are too many for you to handle, even with Lai and Fort's help, so you evacuated everyone to safety at the top of a big tree. You need to get up there, too, but you haven't learned how yet. Maybe Lai can help?
QuestInfo.1: The monsters just won't stop coming. There are too many for you to handle, even with Lai and Fort's help, so you evacuated everyone to safety at the top of a big tree. Lai showed you how to climb by pressing the Up arrow key in front of the vines.
QuestInfo.2: There are too many monsters for you to handle, even with Lai and Fort's help, so you evacuated up the tree along with the townspeople.
